reasoning: The agent shows more than pure-oracle behavior: it studied test assertions up front, validated the build via compile/syntax checks, and — crucially — manually stood up a single fixture and planned curl-based probing plus root-cause diagnosis when the suite failed to start (above anchor 3). But it only ran the full suite once (which never executed a test), never ran relevant test subsets, and never confirmed dev/build/start actually serve or observed SSR/SSG/action behavior, largely because it was blocked in a locked terminal — falling short of anchor 5's functioning targeted-verification loop. This places the observed behavior at 4, between the oracle-only anchor and the subset-driven anchor.
